title: Medallion carpet (red ground)
notes: Medallion carpet (red ground). late 18th century, Khanates Period, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1915. inv. no 753 (3065) from the Mosque of Murad Pasha, Erzurum, Turkey. 180 x 275 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 100.
